d: Chayan Rastogi and Prashant Kapoor will discuss in this video... India vs New Zealand Test match, where Yashasvi Jaiswal and KL Rahul stepped up to hold the fort for Team India in the first innings! With the Indian batting lineup facing a challenging situation, these two batters took responsibility and tried to stabilise the innings. But was this a solid comeback, or are there still plenty of questions about India's batting approach and team strategy? From Yashasvi Jaiswal's batting brilliance to KL Rahul's experience under pressure, we break down India's first innings, the key moments,…
